notes: Three taḥwīl branches. The first two meet at «كلاهما عن الأعمش»; the third writes «حدثنا الأعمش» again and then the Companion chain, so the tail «أبي صالح، أبي هريرة» is written once after the meeting and shared by all three.
«قال أبو بكر إلا أن حفصا لم يقل يريه» is a wording remark; left out.
The archive flagged three routes; this is a reading that a reviewer should check against the tail.
